title: Quiescent current budget
description: From a 24V supply, generate a 5.0V +/-2% reference at node 'vout' (unloaded) while drawing no more than 1mA from the supply. The netlist must contain exactly 'V1 vin 0 DC 24' and a 10 ohm sense resistor 'Rsense vin top 10'; supply current is measured as the drop across Rsense, which must not exceed 0.010V. Build the divider from node 'top' to 'vout' to ground. Return a valid SPICE netlist.
